summary: Payments deploy d-102 (commit c0ffee1, 'simplify refund lookup') removed a null guard in refundTarget(). Deleting `if (!order.customer) return null;` makes `order.customer.account.id` throw a TypeError on any order without a customer. http_5xx_ratio rose from 0.002 to 0.31 within minutes of the deploy. Revert or restore the guard.

evidence.detail: Baseline 0.002 at -30m and -10m; jumped to 0.31 at -5m and held at now, directly after d-102 landed at -9m.
Deploy landed at -9m, carrying commit c0ffee1. Timing aligns with the error-rate spike.
In payments/refund.ts, removed `if (!order.customer) return null;` before `return order.customer.account.id;`, causing a null dereference TypeError for customerless orders.
